question: In the year 1937, the Congress session was held for the first time in a village at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Faizpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Fiftieth (50th) Session **of the **Indian National Congress **was **held between 26 to 28 December 1936 **at **Faizpur**.
 
• It was the **first congress session **to be **held in a village**.
 
• **A large number of peasants **(**Almost 40,000**) **participated **in the session.
 
• **Dhanajinana Choudhari **and **Sane Guruji **played an **important role **in **organizing this session**.
 
• **The Faizpur Session **was important for **the Congress **which had been **raising demands **for the **welfare of the peasants**.
 
• **The Faizpur Session **was also important because it was **presided over by Jawaharlal Nehru **who was at his peak of influence in Congress.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Indian National Congress** is colloquially the Congress Party but often simply the Congress.
 
• It is a **political party **in **India **with **widespread roots**.
 
• It was **founded in 1885**.
 
• it was the **first modern nationalist movement **to **emerge in the British Empire **in **Asia and Africa**.
